name: EXM_RCPT_NOTIF_RULE_SETS
description: This table contains the rules that define the type of receipts that are required, when the individual must be notified of missing and overdue receipts, and when to hold payment to the individual.

columns.name: RCPT_NOTIF_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the rule set that specifies the receipt requirements, overdue processing rules, and payment hold rules.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the receipt and notification rule set.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the receipt and notification rule set.

columns.name: RECEIPT_REQUIRED_CODE
columns.description: Type of receipt required, such as Original, Imaged, or Both.

columns.name: IMG_RECEIPT_DUE_CODE
columns.description: Stage when imaged receipts must be attached to an expense report requiring imaged receipts.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DUE_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days the application waits for required imaged receipts before returning the expense report to the preparer.

columns.name: DEFAULT_RCPT_CHECKIN_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Original receipt package check-in date option. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_DEFAULT_REC_PAC_DT.

columns.name: OVERDUE_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether overdue and missing receipt processing rules are enabled in this rule set.

columns.name: RECEIPT_OVERDUE_DAYS
columns.description: Maximum number of days the application waits before receipts are considered overdue.

columns.name: NOTIF_FILER_OVERDUE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether individuals are notified when receipts are overdue.

columns.name: NEXT_OVERDUE_NOTIF_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days the application waits to send the next overdue notification.

columns.name: OVERDUE_NOTIF_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum number of overdue notifications sent to the individual before the expense report is returned.

columns.name: RCPT_RECEIVED_NOTIF_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of whether individuals are notified when receipts are received.

columns.name: RECPT_MISSING_DECL_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether a missing receipt declaration is required due to missing original receipts.

columns.name: HOLD_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether expense report payment hold rules are enabled in this rule set.

columns.name: HOLD_CODE
columns.description: Payment hold rule that specifies when an expense report is placed on hold, such as when receipt is required and when receipt is overdue.

columns.name: HOLD_REPORT_CODE
columns.description: Type of expense reports placed on payment hold due to overdue receipts.

columns.name: EMP_PAYMENT_HOLD_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of whether expense report of an employee is placed on payment hold.

columns.name: CC_PAYMENT_HOLD_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of whether expense report of corporate card issuer expense report is placed on payment hold.

columns.name: HOLD_PROJECT_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether payment hold rules are applied to expense reports where all expense lines are project-related.

columns.name: NEXT_SHORT_PAY_NOTIF_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days the application waits to send the next short pay notification.

columns.name: SHORT_PAY_NOTIF_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximum number of short pay notifications sent to the individual before the expense report is returned.

columns.name: REQ_MORE_INFO_RESP_DAYS
columns.description: Maximum number of days in which the application expects a response for a notification requesting more information.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
